stem:
Fig. 1.1 is a transverse section through a leaf from the maize plant, *Zea mays*.

Maize is a **C4** plant.

{{figure:figure_1_1.webp}}

Fig. 1.1

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
On Fig. 1.1, use label lines and letters to show:

**A** - a cell in the epidermal layer

**B** - a cell that contains PEP carboxylase.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Identify the cell type labelled **C** in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the leaf anatomy shown in Fig. 1.1 adapts the C4 plant to maintain a high rate of photosynthesis at high temperatures.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Fig. 1.2 shows the results of an experiment comparing the rate of carbon dioxide uptake in a C3 plant (*Chenopodium album*) and a C4 plant (*Amaranthus retroflexus*) in high and low carbon dioxide ($CO_2$) conditions.

The rate of $CO_2$ uptake is used to measure the rate of photosynthesis.

{{figure:figure_1_2.webp}}

Fig. 1.2
parts.text: Using Fig. 1.2, compare the rates of photosynthesis in **high** $CO_2$ conditions in the C3 and C4 plants.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Using Fig. 1.2, compare the rates of photosynthesis in low and high $CO_2$ conditions in the C4 plant between $30^\circ\text{C}$ and $35^\circ\text{C}$ **and** suggest an explanation for this difference.
